author: Dev-next-gen
body:
#### PR description:

This addresses #50121. `TwoTrackMinimumDistanceHelixLine` had two problems in its Newton iteration on the helix turning angle.

When an iterate left the one-turn window around the starting state, every following step was cut to 20%, so the remaining offset only shrank by a factor 0.8 per iteration. That is the decay printed in the issue (0.056 at iteration 12, 0.00385 at iteration 24), and the 12 allowed steps cannot reach the 1e-6 tolerance used by `TwoTrackMinimumDistance::pointsHelixLine`, so the state is reported as failed. In `TrackProducerAlgorithm::buildTrack` a failed TSCBL drops the track, and `TrackFromSeedProducer` returns a charge-0 track.

Nothing checked that the root found is a minimum of the distance either. For low-pT states far from the beam line the iteration often converges to the point of the helix farthest from it, tens of cm away, with a success status.

The existing iteration is kept unchanged. Its result is only accepted if it is a minimum (`derivative * theh < 0`) within one turn of the starting state, so every result it already got right is bit-identical. Otherwise the derivative is sampled at 32 points over the turn, each bracket where the distance has a minimum is refined with Newton steps kept inside the bracket (bisection when a step leaves it), and the closest minimum is returned. If there is no minimum strictly inside the window, the status is still a failure. A unit test is added with the starting state from the issue and a set of prompt tracks seen from outer states.

#### PR validation:

Everything below was run on CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-27-2300 (el9_amd64_gcc15), with this branch on top of master 4379076.

- `scram b` builds without warnings, and the new `TwoTrackMinimumDistanceHelixLine_t` passes (0 failures out of 257; on master it fails 81 of them). For the state in the issue, the PCA is (0.1672, -0.3162, -1.9344), at 0.27476 cm from the beam line, where an independent brute-force minimisation gives 0.27477; master fails on it.
- Workflows 27234.711 (Run4D104, TTbar, LST, tracking only) and 11634.0 (2022 TTbar), 20 events without pileup, step3 re-run on the same step2 with master and with this PR, comparing `generalTracks` and all `seedTracks*` collections event by event. Two runs of master give identical collections.

| | 27234.711 | 11634.0 |
|---|---|---|
| failed (charge 0) seed tracks, master  PR | 81  0 (highPtTripletStepSeedsPixelsWithLST) | 219  0 (tobTecStepSeedsPair 120, pixelLessStepSeeds 47, tobTecStepSeedsTripl 35, displacedRegionalStepSeeds 15, lowPtQuadStepSeeds 2) |
| successful on master, failed with the PR | 0 | 0 |
| other changed tracks | 82, all with a smaller \|dxy\| | 307, all with a smaller \|dxy\| |
| all other tracks | bit-identical | bit-identical |
| `generalTracks` | 2553, bit-identical | 3045  3046, the others bit-identical |

The extra general track is a tobTecStep track (pT 0.535 GeV, dxy 6.8 cm) that master dropped because its TSCBL failed.

- Standalone check of the real `TwoTrackMinimumDistanceHelixLine.cc` against a brute-force reference, 100k tracks per sample (pT 0.3-10 GeV, |eta| < 3, starting states at 3-110 cm). Prompt tracks: master fails 1.94% and converges to the farthest point for 4.61%, the PR 0 and 0. Tracks displaced up to 60 cm: master 2.02% and 4.61%, the PR 0.001% and 0. Among the tracks master got right, 95% are bit-identical and none ends up farther from the line. Calls that reach the fallback cost about 1.7 s more; the others are unchanged.

What I could not run: the reproducer from the issue with PU200 and `HLT:75e33_trackingOnly`, since I have no access to the minbias files on EOS, so the LST numbers above are offline tracking without pileup.

A follow-up PR, #52336, computes the helix radius from pT in double precision. It is independent in purpose but meant to go on top of this one.

title: Fix TwoTrackMinimumDistanceHelixLine failing or converging to the farthest point
